Synopsis:
    Attorney Kevin Reddington publicly requested a presidential pardon for Lindsay Clancy, a Massachusetts mother whose murder trial ended in a mistrial after jurors deadlocked. Clancy was accused of killing her three children in January 2023, with her defense citing postpartum psychosis. The pardon request is legally questionable as presidential clemency only covers federal crimes, though Trump has previously stretched this precedent with the Tina Peters state-level pardon. Trump's public comments suggest he is unsympathetic; prosecutors may seek a retrial.
